patch_description:
This implementation keeps the hierarchical topology-aware structure, but replaces the purely one-pass group packing behavior with a bounded local-refinement strategy.

The initial placement still uses fast largest-first heap scheduling, which provides a strong starting solution efficiently. After this placement, a small number of deterministic exchanges between the currently heaviest and lightest packs is evaluated. An exchange is accepted only when it strictly improves the global load-range objective (with squared load deviation as a tie-breaker). This preserves exact per-pack capacity while improving GPU and node balance in cases where greedy placement becomes trapped in a locally suboptimal arrangement.

It also adds safe fast paths for one-pack, one-item-per-pack, and exactly uniform weights. These cases need no sorting, heap operations, or refinement and directly construct a stable contiguous mapping.
